bug_fixed.issue: TEMPO and VARIANCE sections showing '-' instead of actual values
bug_fixed.root_cause: In PlayerDetailPage.jsx, the intel_suite merge logic at line 540 was using `clickedProp.intel_suite || prop.intel_suite`. When user clicks a player card from dashboard, the clickedProp comes from tier endpoint (safe-haven/front-lines/war-zone) which has partial intel_suite with only 'lasso'. The player detail API returns full intel_suite with tempo, stability_index, etc. The || operator was causing the partial intel_suite to override the full one.
bug_fixed.fix: Changed line 540 from `intel_suite: clickedProp.intel_suite || prop.intel_suite` to `intel_suite: { ...(prop.intel_suite || {}), ...(clickedProp.intel_suite || {}) }` to merge both objects and preserve all fields.

rca_of_the_issue.symptom: TEMPO and VARIANCE sections in Vision Intel Suite modal showing '-' instead of actual values
rca_of_the_issue.investigation: 1. Verified backend APIs return correct intel_suite data with tempo and stability_index. 2. Added console logging to handleVisionClick to inspect prop data. 3. Found that prop.intel_suite only contained {lasso: Object} but not tempo or stability_index.
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The merge logic in PlayerDetailPage.jsx line 540 used `clickedProp.intel_suite || prop.intel_suite`. The clickedProp from tier endpoint had partial intel_suite (only lasso), which was truthy, so it overrode the full intel_suite from player detail API.
rca_of_the_issue.fix: Changed to object spread merge: `intel_suite: { ...(prop.intel_suite || {}), ...(clickedProp.intel_suite || {}) }` to combine both objects.
rca_of_the_issue.verification: After fix, TEMPO shows +7%/+2% and VARIANCE shows 70% correctly.
